gbm_population_evidence.quote: Melanoma; Medullary Thyroid Cancer; Sinonasal Undifferentiated Carcinoma; Esthesioneuroblastoma; Bladder Cancer; Testicular Cancer; Glioblastoma Multiforme; Cervical Cancer; Large Cell Neuroendocrine Carcinoma of the Lung; Non Small Cell Lung Cancer; Merkel Cell Carcinoma
including but not limited to: melanoma, medullary thyroid cancer, esthesioneuroblastoma, bladder cancer, testicular cancer, glioblastoma multiforme, cervical cancer;

candidate_evidence.quote: A Phase I/II Study of AMG757 / Tarlatamab and Concurrent Radiation Therapy in Tumors With High Prevalence of DLL3

[EXPERIMENTAL] Tarlatamab Monotherapy Cohort: If the sequential safety endpoint is not met, then the study will proceed to another de-escalation phase, where 10 patients will receive tarlatamab alone.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Subjects who progressed or recurred after at least one line of therapy and are considered treatment refractory per standard of care.

role_evidence.quote: [EXPERIMENTAL] Concurrent Main Cohort: Patients enrolled to this cohort will receive tarlatamab with concurrent radiation therapy (RT) to extracranial sites

agents.drug_class_hint: DLL3 x CD3 bispecific T-cell engager (AMG757)

source_quote.quote: DLL3+ (≥1% by IHC) Note: If patients are DLL3 negative per IHC but have a DLL3 prevalant tumor type, they will be allowed to enroll on the study.

flag.reason: DLL3 positivity is one alternative entry route, not a strict requirement: DLL3-negative patients with a DLL3-prevalent histology (including GBM) may enrol, so it may not count as an eligibility biomarker.

coder_notes: Multi-histology basket of DLL3-prevalent relapsed/refractory tumours; glioblastoma multiforme named in conditions and inclusion. Tarlatamab is the only drug; radiotherapy is concurrent or sequential in three of four cohorts, so regimen combination (the de-escalation monotherapy cohort is tarlatamab alone). Four sequential experimental cohorts, none a control. DLL3 selection: entry allowed by DLL3-prevalent histology OR DLL3+ IHC, with DLL3-negative patients of prevalent types allowed; coded eligibility/candidate-matched with uncertain flag for adjudication.
